metadata.title: Bulk RNA-seq Analysis Pipeline (nf-core/rnaseq: QC → trim → align → quantify)
metadata.purpose: Take a samplesheet of paired-end FASTQ files and produce a gene/transcript expression matrix plus an aggregated QC report, by running read QC, adapter/quality trimming, strandedness inference, genome alignment (STAR) and transcript quantification (Salmon), followed by post-alignment QC gates.
metadata.scope: Reference-based bulk RNA-seq of organisms with a genome assembly and annotation, using the default nf-core/rnaseq v3.14.0 star_salmon route. Out of scope: de novo assembly, single-cell RNA-seq, HISAT2/RSEM routes (available but not encoded here), and downstream differential-expression modelling beyond the pipeline's built-in DESeq2 QC.
metadata.estimatedTime: ~4-12 h wall-clock for a typical human dataset on an HPC/cloud executor (dominated by STAR alignment); highly dataset- and compute-dependent.
beforeYouBegin: Install Nextflow (>=25.04.3 for the current release; v3.14.0 requires Nextflow >=23.04.0) and a container engine (Docker/Singularity/Conda).
Prepare a samplesheet CSV (see table t1) with one row per FASTQ pair and a strandedness column ('auto' lets the pipeline infer it).
Obtain a reference genome FASTA and matching GTF annotation, or specify an --genome iGenomes key so the pipeline builds the STAR/Salmon indices.
Decide compute resources: STAR needs ~38 GB RAM for the human GRCh37 index; set process resource limits accordingly.

materials.name: Reference genome FASTA
materials.specification: Genome assembly for the target organism (e.g. GRCh38); supplied via --fasta or an --genome iGenomes key. Digital input, not a physical reagent.

materials.name: Genome annotation GTF
materials.specification: Gene models matching the FASTA; supplied via --gtf. Used to build the transcriptome and to assign reads to genes.

materials.name: rRNA database (SortMeRNA)
materials.specification: Ribosomal RNA sequence set used only when --remove_ribo_rna is enabled (default: off). Digital reference.

materials.name: Samplesheet CSV
materials.specification: Input manifest of FASTQ files; see table t1 for column layout.

equipment.name: FastQC (software tool)
equipment.settings: Per-read quality metrics on raw and trimmed FASTQ.

equipment.name: Salmon (software tool)
equipment.settings: Used both for strandedness inference (subsampled) and for transcript quantification from STAR alignments.

equipment.name: STAR (software tool; aligner)
equipment.settings: Default aligner (--aligner star_salmon); spliced alignment to the genome.

equipment.name: RSeQC / Qualimap / dupRadar / Preseq (QC tools)
equipment.settings: Post-alignment QC; Preseq skipped by default.

equipment.name: MultiQC (software tool)
equipment.settings: Aggregates all module logs into one HTML report.

samples.name: Raw paired-end FASTQ reads
samples.description: One or more FASTQ pairs per biological sample, listed in the samplesheet (t1). Digital sequencing dataset.

samples.name: Coordinate-sorted genome BAM
samples.description: STAR alignments, sorted and indexed by SAMtools.

samples.name: Gene/transcript expression matrix
samples.description: Salmon quantifications merged across samples (counts + TPM), plus a DESeq2 VST-based sample-similarity QC.

samples.name: MultiQC report
samples.description: Single aggregated HTML QC report for the run.

tables.title: Input samplesheet layout (--input samplesheet.csv)
tables.note: One row per FASTQ pair; rows sharing a 'sample' value are merged (technical replicates). 'strandedness' may be auto|forward|reverse|unstranded. Example rows adapted from the nf-core/rnaseq docs; substitute real paths.

tables.title: QC gates and key default parameters (nf-core/rnaseq v3.14.0)
rows: Samples with fewer reads after trimming are removed from downstream analysis.
Percent (%) uniquely-mapped reads below which a BAM is failed/flagged (STAR route).
Use VST (not rlog) for the DESeq2 sample-similarity QC.
SortMeRNA rRNA depletion off by default.
Host/contaminant BBSplit removal off by default.
Preseq library-complexity estimation off by default.
tables.note: Values verified against the nf-core/rnaseq v3.14.0 parameters page.

steps.action: Stage the run: provide --input samplesheet.csv (t1), the reference FASTA + GTF, choose an executor profile, and launch `nextflow run nf-core/rnaseq -r 3.14.0`.
steps.expectedResult: Pipeline resolves the samplesheet and reference; work directory initialised.
steps.criticalNotes: LOOP: the pipeline runs steps s2-s10 once per samplesheet row/sample in parallel; the schema has no loop construct, so per-sample iteration is expressed only via the samplesheet table (t1) and this note.

steps.action: Concatenate FASTQ files that belong to the same sample (technical replicates) with `cat`.
steps.expectedResult: One merged R1/R2 pair per sample.

steps.action: Run FastQC on the raw reads to capture per-base quality, GC and adapter-contamination metrics.
steps.expectedResult: Per-sample FastQC report; no hard gate, informs trimming.

steps.action: Infer library strandedness by subsampling reads and pseudo-mapping with Salmon (only when strandedness='auto' in t1).
steps.expectedResult: Strandedness assigned per sample for downstream quantification.

branches.condition: If samplesheet strandedness is explicit (forward/reverse/unstranded), skip inference and use the stated value.

steps.action: Trim adapters and low-quality bases with Trim Galore!, then re-run FastQC on trimmed reads.

branches.condition: if trimmed reads for a sample < min_trimmed_reads (10000)
branches.action: Remove that sample from all downstream steps (fails the trimming QC gate).

steps.expectedResult: Adapter-free trimmed FASTQ (sp2) passing the 10,000-read gate.
steps.criticalNotes: QC GATE encoded as a branch: schema has no dedicated acceptance-threshold field, so the numeric gate lives in parameters + branches + table t2.

steps.action: (Optional) Remove genome contaminants with BBSplit and/or deplete rRNA with SortMeRNA.

parameters.rawText: skip_bbsplit = true (default off); remove_ribo_rna = false (default off)

steps.expectedResult: Cleaned reads when enabled; otherwise passthrough.
steps.criticalNotes: Both sub-steps are OFF by default; enable via --bbsplit_fasta_list / --remove_ribo_rna.

steps.action: Align trimmed reads to the genome with STAR (default --aligner star_salmon).

parameters.rawText: STAR needs ~38 GB RAM for the human GRCh37 index

steps.criticalNotes: COMPUTE PARAMETER: memory is a resource requirement, not a bench quantity; encoded via parameter.type 'dataSize'. Value is the documented GRCh37 figure and is genome-dependent (needsReview).

steps.action: Sort and index alignments with SAMtools; optionally mark duplicates with picard.
steps.expectedResult: Coordinate-sorted, indexed BAM with duplicate flags.

steps.action: Quantify transcript/gene expression with Salmon against the STAR alignments; build the k-mer index if needed.
Run post-alignment QC (RSeQC, Qualimap, dupRadar) and apply the mapping-rate gate.
steps.expectedResult: QC metrics per sample; low-mapping samples flagged.
steps.criticalNotes: QC GATE: percentage acceptance threshold has no native parameter.type; encoded as type 'other' with unit '%' plus a branch.

steps.action: Merge per-sample quantifications into a study-wide matrix, run DESeq2 sample-similarity QC (VST), and aggregate every module log into a MultiQC report.
steps.expectedResult: Gene/transcript expression matrix (sp4) and a single MultiQC HTML report (sp5).
steps.criticalNotes: COMPUTED RESULT: the merged matrix is derived from all per-sample outputs; the schema has no 'derived/aggregated result' construct, so it is modelled as an output sample plus expectedOutputs.

controls.name: Strandedness sanity check
controls.description: Salmon-inferred strandedness should match the library-prep kit expectation; mismatches indicate a samplesheet or kit error.

controls.name: Sample-similarity QC (DESeq2 VST)
controls.description: PCA/heatmap should cluster replicates together; outliers suggest swaps or batch effects.

controls.name: Positive/negative biological controls
controls.description: Spike-ins or known housekeeping genes if included in the experimental design.

expectedOutputs: Gene- and transcript-level expression matrices (raw counts and TPM) merged across all samples.
A single MultiQC HTML report aggregating FastQC, trimming, alignment, quantification and QC-tool metrics.
Per-sample BAM alignments, coverage bigWig tracks, and QC tables in the results directory.
A software_versions.yml recording the exact tool versions used for the run (resolves the version-pinning gaps flagged as needsReview here).

troubleshooting.solution: Check raw read depth and adapter settings; lower --min_trimmed_reads only if justified.

troubleshooting.cause: Wrong reference, contamination, or degraded RNA
troubleshooting.solution: Verify genome/GTF match; enable BBSplit; inspect RSeQC read distribution.

troubleshooting.cause: Index too large for allocated RAM (~38 GB for human)
troubleshooting.solution: Increase process memory or use a shared/prebuilt index.

troubleshooting.cause: Mislabelled library or wrong samplesheet column
troubleshooting.solution: Set strandedness explicitly instead of 'auto' and re-run the affected samples.

safety: Purely computational protocol: no physical, chemical, or biological hazards. Standard data-governance/privacy rules apply to human sequencing data.
limitations: Encodes only the default star_salmon route of nf-core/rnaseq v3.14.0; HISAT2/RSEM routes, UMI handling, and full differential-expression modelling are not represented. Individual tool version numbers were not pinned from the source and are marked needsReview; the run's software_versions.yml is authoritative.
